content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurance underwriter and annuity seller; it takes premiums and pays claims rather than managing investment funds for fees."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory services firm; it sells professional services rather than managing investment capital."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manages mainly public equity and fixed income mutual funds for retail and institutions, not private market alternatives."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Manages real asset strategies such as real estate and infrastructure for institutions via commingled funds and separate accounts, overlapping GCM's real assets line."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Life and annuity insurer that funds products with premiums; asset management is secondary to insurance."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manages public equity and fixed income mutual funds and ETFs for advisers and retail investors, not alternatives."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Research, ratings, data and software business; its portfolio management is a minor line, not its core model."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Operates over-the-counter trading venues and disclosure services for public companies, not an investment manager."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Manages private equity fund-of-funds, private credit and venture debt for institutions and family offices, earning management fees on capital."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Wealth management for high-net-worth individuals and families through separate accounts; no alternatives or institutional fund platform."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Provides financial software and outsourced back-office operations to asset managers, not investment management itself."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Affiliated boutique managers selling mutual funds through advisers to retail investors; mainly traditional strategies."}]}
